sources.title: Visas to Jordan
sources.officialityEvidence: Jordan's live official tourism-board nationality table directly maps Nauru to a visa obtainable on arrival.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Nauru | Applicable | Visa can be obtained upon arrival

policies.title: Nauruan ordinary passports: Jordan visitor visa on arrival
policies.summary: Jordan's official nationality table says Nauruan visitors can obtain a visa on arrival.
conditions: Applies to a Nauruan ordinary passport holder travelling as a short visitor.
Jordan's page instructs non-Jordanian visitors to register through Gateway2Jordan before departure and present the resulting QR code.
Restricted crossings, non-visitor purposes and final admission remain outside scope.
